page.content:
Heavy infantry unit that built and held the empire.

How Roman legion connects

  • Faction: Roman Republic — The manipular legion was the Republic's army.
  • Faction: Roman Empire — The standing legion was the Empire's occupation force.
  • Character: Julius Caesar — Caesar's loyalty-bound legions made the Rubicon possible.

What is Roman legion?

The legion — from manipular Republic to imperial cohort structure — was Rome's tool of conquest, engineering, and occupation. Loyalty to generals rather than Senate unmade the Republic.

Key threads lead to Roman Republic, Roman Empire and Julius Caesar.
